description.text:
The peaceful homeland of hobbits, with its rolling green hills and cozy hobbit-holes. Here begins the greatest journey of the Third Age. 

Take up the Ring, leave the Shire behind, and begin the long road to Mordor.
A bustling village where Men and Hobbits live side by side. The Prancing Pony inn stands at the crossroads of the ancient Great East Road.
The Last Homely House, hidden valley refuge of the Elves. Here the Fellowship was formed under Elrond's guidance.
The Golden Wood, realm of Galadriel and Celeborn. Ancient mallorn trees tower above, and time itself seems to move differently here.
The green lawn beside the Falls of Rauros, where the Fellowship was broken. Here the Company made their fateful choice.
The Morannon, mighty fortress guarding the entrance to Mordor. Impassable to all but the most desperate or foolish.
The Tower of Sorcery, once fair Minas Ithil. Now a place of dread, glowing with a corpse-light under the shadow of the mountains.
Orodruin, the Fire Mountain where the One Ring was forged and where it must be destroyed. The end of all things, or a new beginning.
